hints.title: Interval Difference Array
hints.text: Instead of incrementing every flight in a booking individually, apply difference values at the start and just past the end of each flight interval.

hints.title: Marking Interval Boundaries
hints.text: For booking [first, last, seats], add seats at index first minus 1, and subtract seats at index last if last is within bounds.

hints.title: Running Prefix Accumulation
hints.text: Perform a single prefix sum sweep from index 1 to n minus 1 to compute the final seat count for each flight.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Updating each flight range individually takes O(B * N) time, which times out for large flight ranges.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array marks boundaries in O(1) and recovers all answers in a single O(N) sweep.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as standard 1D range update and prefix sum accumulation.
complexity.notes: 1-indexed flight numbers are mapped to 0-indexed positions.
